Job Purpose

Drive SIM Card sales growth through digital channel acquisition, strategic partnerships, and bundling initiatives. Develop new distribution opportunities and scale sales across official stores, live shopping, e-commerce bundling, and device marketplace sellers.

Scope of Responsibility

1. Official Store & Live Shopping: Develop official brand stores across digital marketplaces; acquire live-shopping opportunities; collaborate with marketplace teams, creators, affiliates, and marketing teams; improve campaign performance and conversion.

2. E-Commerce Bundling SIM Card: Acquire and develop e-commerce partnerships for SIM Card bundling; design bundle mechanics and promotions; coordinate commercial terms, technical integration, and campaign execution; optimize sales and acquisition.

3. Device Marketplace Sellers Bundling: Acquire smartphone sellers and device distributors on digital marketplaces; establish SIM Card bundles with device purchases; develop seller incentives; monitor seller productivity, bundle adoption, and sales contribution.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify, prospect, and acquire new digital partners, marketplace sellers, and distribution opportunities.
• Build a qualified partner pipeline based on sales potential, customer reach, and strategic fit; lead negotiations and deal closures.
• Achieve SIM Card sales targets across assigned digital sub-channels and develop scalable bundling models.
• Design commercial propositions, incentives, and promotional programs to increase acquisition and bundle attachment.
• Prepare partnership proposals, business cases, and commercial models.
• Coordinate partner onboarding, technical integration, marketing activities, and operational readiness with internal teams.
• Monitor sales performance, acquisition contribution, seller productivity, and bundling effectiveness.
• Develop corrective action plans for underperforming channels and scale successful partnership models.

Requirements

• Relevant experience in Business Development, Digital Partnerships, E-Commerce, Marketplace Acquisition, or Sales is preferred.
• Experience acquiring new partners and closing commercial agreements is strongly preferred.
• Understanding of e-commerce marketplaces, official stores, live shopping, and smartphone/device seller ecosystems.
• Proven ability to develop commercial propositions and execute sales or bundling programs.
• Strong negotiation, networking, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
• Commercially driven, proactive, and comfortable working toward ambitious sales targets.
• Strong analytical skills to evaluate performance and identify growth opportunities.
• Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Telecommunications, SIM Card distribution, digital commerce, or smartphone retail experience is an advantage.

Recommended experience level: 3–5 years in a relevant role, with flexibility for candidates demonstrating strong acquisition and commercial execution capabilities.

Employment Status:

Permanent (P)

wo-klbf-JR26_000986.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Operate production machinery and equipment, ensuring adherence to schedules and standards.
- Perform regular maintenance and repairs on equipment to ensure optimal performance.
- Identify and resolve production issues to minimize downtime.
- Ensure adherence to production schedules and standards, maintaining high levels of quality.
- Maintain a clean and safe work environment, following all safety protocols and regulations.
- Assist in the implementation of production improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
- Coordinate with other team members to ensure smooth production processes.

- Mengoperasikan mesin dan peralatan produksi, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar.
- Melakukan pemeliharaan dan perbaikan rutin pada peralatan untuk memastikan kinerja optimal.
- Mengidentifikasi dan memecahkan masalah produksi untuk meminimalkan waktu henti.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar produksi, menjaga tingkat kualitas yang tinggi.
- Memelihara lingkungan kerja yang bersih dan aman, mengikuti semua protokol dan regulasi keselamatan.
- Mendukung implementasi perbaikan produksi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan mengurangi biaya.
- Berkoordinasi dengan anggota tim lain untuk memastikan proses produksi yang lancar.

Company:
DF PT. Dankos Farma
